description: Every spoken word with its start and end time, for a clip (video_id), an audio track (audio_id) or an uploaded file (project_id + asset_key). Use it to cut pauses without cutting into a word, to time captions, or to land a graphic on an exact word — instead of guessing seconds from the waveform. Up to 20 min of sound per source; the first call transcribes (Fish Audio, about 0.36 USD per audio hour, booked to the operator, not your credits), every later call for the same sound is served from the cache for free. Returns at most 300 s of words per page; continue with `weiter_von_s`. Speech recognition spells names the way they sound — check names before you put them on screen.

asset_key.description: Storage key of an uploaded sound or video file (from lab_add_media). Needs project_id

bis_s.description: End of the page; at most 300 s after von_s

project_id.description: Project the asset_key belongs to — required with asset_key

sprache.description: Spoken language (default de) — the same list the backend accepts

video_id.description: Generated video id — its own soundtrack. Give exactly one of video_id, audio_id, asset_key

von_s.description: Start of the page in seconds (default 0)

name: lab_wortzeiten
title: Spoken words
